2.title: Surah Al-Fatihah (The Opening) - Verse 1 of 7
2.translationMaulana: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
2.translationYusuf: In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
2.annotations: The Basmala (Invocation) opens every action in Islamic practice. Ar-Rahman (Beneficent) refers to mercy embracing all creation through provision and sustenance. Ar-Rahim (Merciful) refers to mercy toward believers in spiritual matters and the Hereafter. This invocation reconnects the believer to divine guidance. The Honorable Elijah Muhammad taught this is the key to all knowledge—establishing that nothing exists independently; all derives from Allah's mercy. For the Mukhlasin practitioner, this invocation before fasting reestablishes consciousness that physical sustenance flows from divine benevolence.
